sevenzip-wasm 26.5.0, compiled from 7-Zip 26.05 (Alone2)

Copyright 1999–2026 Igor Pavlov and other contributors. The generated
JavaScript/WebAssembly is LGPL-2.1-or-later with the unRAR restriction; see
LICENSE. The restriction prohibits using the RAR code to re-create the RAR
compression algorithm. Michiflin does not offer creation of RAR archives.

The complete corresponding upstream sources and build scripts are included
alongside this notice, in losslessly recompressed XZ archives. Their extracted
tar streams are byte-for-byte identical to the gzip archives in the project
repository; no files have been removed. To rebuild, unpack
source-wrapper-26.5.0.tar.xz and unpack source-7zip-26.05.tar.xz into its
7zip subdirectory (the upstream git submodule), then follow build.sh and
README.md in the wrapper source. Emscripten and its toolchain are needed
separately. The two packaged library files are separate assets and may be
replaced with a compatible rebuilt copy. Extract using a tool with XZ support,
for example: tar -xf source-7zip-26.05.tar.xz

Upstream wrapper tag 26.5.0, commit 7b53d4abf78d:
https://github.com/arktronic/sevenzip-wasm/tree/26.5.0
Upstream 7-Zip 26.05, commit b88c6bc09339:
https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/tree/26.05
